bear.last: XRP/USD: The XRP/USD pair sits at $1.107, well below its 20‑day ($1.255), 50‑day ($1.365) and 200‑day ($1.267) moving averages, confirming a strong bearish bias that has produced a 17% drop over the past 20 days.
